categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic specialty gases and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid series products. It has expanded into high-purity metals and precursor materials, as well as bulk on-site gas supply business. Key product categories include high-purity electronic gases used in semiconductor and display panel manufacturing, trifluoromethanesulfonic acid derivatives, and high-purity metals such as tungsten and molybdenum.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including electrochemical fluorination, chemical synthesis, distillation, chemical purification, adsorption, gas mixing, trace impurity analysis, and filling technologies. It has developed proprietary processes for high-purity gas synthesis and purification, with several core technologies at international leading levels. The production involves synthesis, purification, analysis, and filling, with strict quality and environmental controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor and display panel manufacturers such as TSMC, Micron, SK Hynix, Intel, Infineon, GlobalFoundries, SMIC, BOE, and TCL Huaxing. The company also serves industries including lithium battery materials, pharmaceuticals, and chemical intermediates. Its products are critical inputs for integrated circuit fabrication, display panel production, and new energy materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Handan (Hebei Province), Shanghai, and Hohhot. It has established regional service centers and warehouses across major domestic semiconductor and display manufacturing hubs including Shanghai, Hefei, Chongqing, and Shenzhen. Internationally, it serves customers in Singapore, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Europe, and North America, with offices in South Korea and Japan to enhance overseas market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing high-purity specialty gases and materials essential for semiconductor and display manufacturing. It integrates upstream raw material processing with downstream direct sales and technical services to end customers, positioning itself as a key materials supplier within the semiconductor and related industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technological innovation in electronic specialty gases and fluorine-containing new materials, expanding production capacity, and enhancing global market presence. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new product development, process optimization, and green manufacturing technologies. It actively participates in national key projects and industry collaborations to maintain technological leadership and accelerate product industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-purity electronic specialty gases, trifluoromethanesulfonic acid series products, and high-purity metals. The company employs a direct sales model to end customers, supplemented by limited sales through distributors. Pricing is negotiated on a case-by-case basis considering production costs, customer volume, and service requirements. Additional income arises from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading domestic producer of electronic specialty gases in China and ranks ninth globally in integrated circuit electronic specialty gas sales. It competes with international giants such as Linde, Air Liquide, Taiyo Nippon Sanso, and Air Products. While there is a technology and scale gap with global leaders, the company holds strong competitive advantages in certain product segments and is recognized as a domestic industry leader with growing international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.93 billion, a 19.33% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 304 million. Total assets reached RMB 6.29 billion, growing 7.65% from the previous year. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity, increased product variety, and enhanced market penetration domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product purity, stability, and reliability tailored for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes. It offers a broad product portfolio with over 85 products, including proprietary high-purity gases and materials with international leading technologies. Its integrated service network, strong R&D capabilities, and compliance with stringent quality and environmental standards provide customers with comprehensive, high-quality, and innovative specialty gas solutions, supporting critical manufacturing processes in semiconductor and display industries.
